profile.positioning: As Founder & CEO of Aether Health, I’m building the future of proactive, personalized healthcare. We’re developing an AI-powered platform that analyzes individual biometric data, lifestyle factors, and genetic predispositions to create hyper-personalized preventative health plans. The current healthcare system is reactive – treating illness *after* it manifests. Aether Health flips that model, focusing on predicting and preventing disease through actionable insights and tailored interventions. We're not just delivering data; we’re translating it into a roadmap for optimal wellbeing. My background in executive search, spanning over 15 years at the highest levels, has uniquely positioned me to identify and attract top-tier talent in both AI and healthcare. This isn’t just a business for me; it’s a mission born from witnessing the limitations of the current system firsthand and recognizing the incredible potential of preventative medicine. We're currently in the seed stage, conducting pilot programs with select partners, and are on track for Series A funding in Q1 2025. The core value proposition is simple: extending healthspan and improving quality of life through proactive, data-driven wellness.
